correctness.rationale: After affine normalization to support (0,t,1), direct differentiation gives kappa'(t)=4abc t(1-t)[(3b-1)t+(3c-1)]/V(t)^3. The positive prefactor and affine bracket completely determine stationarity and monotonicity. Boundary limits are exact two-level kurtoses, and substitution at the unique interior root yields (1-3s2)/(s2-9s3). Exact-rational replay independently checks the derivative and formulas.
